hypothesis: The byte-identical Clang Q4_K tile win shifts enough exclusive cycles into Q8xQ8, Q6_K, OpenMP, or other graph work that an isolated Q4_K optimization no longer has a sufficient Amdahl ceiling. A paired long-repetition profile will identify the minimum composition capable of the 1.40x whole-model target.

protocol.raw_perf_data_policy: hash then delete after reports are sealed

selection_rules: Compute the candidate cycle shares and Amdahl ceilings before editing another kernel.
Use the independently confirmed 1.152529 Q4_K native speedup when calculating whether Q4_K plus any single other group can reach 1.40x.
If Q4_K plus an infinitely fast Q8xQ8 group still cannot reach 1.40x, reject a two-kernel-only plan and require trained approximation or at least a three-group composition.
Do not interpret model-load repacking or page-fault shares as steady-state decode work.
Do not make a speed, quality, or novelty claim from a sampling profile.
promotion_boundary: This diagnostic selects the next implementation lane. It does not promote a runtime or satisfy any throughput or capability gate.
